routing_rules.description: Route only the Simple tier to MiniMax-M3.1-Flash. The complexity analyzer classifies the request with TypeSafe Jev and publishes the result as the CEL variable complexity_tier; classification runs at all only because this rule references it. Deliberately downward-only: SIMPLE is the only tier with a target, so MEDIUM and COMPLEX keep the caller's model through route-anthropic-native. Pinning a model on the higher tiers would override Claude Code's per-slot selection and would move the haiku slot onto the heavy model. The header guard keeps this off direct-SDK callers: the security-review plugin asks for claude-opus-5-5 without the x-bf-route header and depends on its Sonnet fallback, which MiniMax-M3's adaptive thinking truncates. Priority 3 puts it ahead of route-anthropic-native at priority 5 -- routing rules are first-match-wins with the lower number evaluated first, and Claude Code sends x-bf-route on every request.
routing_rules.name: Simple Tasks → Concise Model

routing_rules.description: Pin Claude Code to the Anthropic-native MiniMax provider. The gateway config defines two providers that both claim MiniMax-M3, and bare model-name resolution cannot choose between them: the OpenAI-compatible one returns reasoning inline in the assistant text, while this one returns genuine Anthropic responses with thinking blocks. The target pins the provider only -- upstream keeps the incoming model when a target omits it -- because Claude Code picks the model per request class (MiniMax-M3 for the opus and sonnet slots, MiniMax-M3.1-Flash for the haiku slot) and a pinned model would silently move the fast slot onto the heavy model. The fallback stays on the Anthropic-native provider: the Anthropic ingress bridges every request to the 'responses' request type, which the chat-completions-only 'minimax-openai' provider cannot serve.
routing_rules.name: Anthropic-Native Claude Code Route

routing_rules.description: Route vision requests to MiniMax's multimodal model. Both M3 and M3.1-Flash accept image input on the OpenAI-compatible surface (image_url blocks, verified live against this gateway on 2026-11-06); M3.1-Flash is the cheaper of the two and read charts and documents with equal accuracy in an A/B on 2026-11-06.
routing_rules.name: Vision Tasks
